title: Birthplace, Uptown childhood and birth date
summary: She was born in New Orleans, grew up Uptown and the Garden District, distinguishes the Irish Channel, and gives her birth date July 14, 1891; widowed at 26.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: 3143, 2 o'clock. Were you born in this neighborhood? No, sir. Where were you born? I was born in New Orleans, but not in this neighborhood. I don't remember. I had to ask. My mother's not here to ask for that. I don't remember.
But where did you grow up? What neighborhood did you grow up in?
I grew up in the Uptown neighborhood. I've always lived Uptown. Around this way, the Garden District, that they call it. I lived out in Chippewater. Used to call that the, what?
But I didn't call it the Irish Channel. Out for the St. Thomas Street was Irish Channel.
Further downtown and closer to the river is the Irish Channel.
No, not too far down. It goes down as far, I believe, as out Felicity. I passed that way. Not very far. All out the river, St. Thomas Street, that's what you call Irish Channel.
I hate to ask this question, but do you mind giving the exact date of your birth? You don't have to.

No, I can't say I'm 39. July the 14th, 1891. 1891? I was just figuring up with Yvonne. I was a widow when I was 26. I said, when was that, Yvonne? For goodness sake, Mommy, you forgot the figure. She had to figure it out for me. At 26, I was a widow. That's when I enjoyed my dancing.
